query: select n.nspname as schema_name, t.typname as enum_name, e.enumlabel as label, e.enumsortorder as sort_order from pg_catalog.pg_type t join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=t.typnamespace join pg_catalog.pg_enum e on e.enumtypid=t.oid where n.nspname in ('public','private') order by 1,2,4;
